notes.title: Missing Time: Sumire's Arrival!
notes.content:
Dearest players,

Thank you for following our journey in Komachi High! With this major update, we are proud to introduce our 5th girl, Sumire Murasaki, into the main game with her own endings! Prepare to view the mysteries of Komachi in an outsider's perspective, and tread this unknown water with our bubbly junior! 

Secrets, whispered rumors and strange events keep making their marks throughout the school year ... Can Sumire lead you towards the light? Or will she be your downfall? That remains for you to decide. Or is it?

This updates adds new free contents to the story, and some changes to the gameplay. Below are the contents to the update, with spoiler hidden:

[list]
[*] A brand new route is added to the main storyline [spoiler]that greatly diverges from the existing routes.[/spoiler]
[*] 3 new CG's by SydusArts.
[*] [spoiler]Sumire's route can be entered by declining to join the Occult Club in scene 2.[/spoiler]
[*] Dream sequence added at the beginning as a choice. 
[*] Shizuyo's route now replaces Chiharu's route as the free game. We felt she best represented the original vision of Missing Time.
[/list]

Thank you so much for your support, and we hope to see you in Komachi soon!

With love,

Fluttering Abyss

notes.title: Missing Time - Time Goes On
notes.content:
Dearest players,

Thank you for following our journey in Komachi High! Our 9th ending is now available! This updates adds new free contents to the story, and some changes to the gameplay. Below are the contents to the update, with spoiler hidden.

[list]
[*] A 9th alternative ending is added [spoiler] after Chiharu's death in Chapter 1. The game will automatically enter this ending after you found Chiharu's CG in the Storage Room. [/spoiler] 
[*] 3 new CG's.
[*] 2 new characters (with sprites!)
[*] Visible timed mechanics have been removed and replaced with [Wait] option. [spoiler] Secret timer events still work as normal [/spoiler]
[/list]

Thank you so much for your support, and we hope to see you in Komachi soon!

With love,

Fluttering Abyss
